And the truth is that America was founded with very libertarian principles. Now, they didn't follow those principles from the very beginning. They put things down on paper they didn't believe in. And so within our culture, we have a set of principles that are widely believed. I don't think Americans appreciate enough how similar a lot of these basic principles we have are compared to people who have grown up in other countries and lived there for a long time. We don't have those same views. It's ingrained in us. A lot of classical liberal ideas are really ingrained in the American system. Many Americans hold libertarian principles deeply embedded in cultural and constitutional traditions, despite not consistently applying them.
It is more effective to establish agreement on principles before seeking alignment on specific viewpoints.
